samples.title: Sales and Marketing Manager, North America

reads.need: Almost no work is posted in town
reads.evidence: 76 postings in 30 days for 8,934 households: under one for every 100 households, the lowest rate of the ten.
reads.quality: Nearly everyone who lives here works somewhere else. The town is a place to live, not a place to work.
reads.move: Count the restaurant, bar and shop jobs along Pier Avenue directly. They are the town's real employers and they are missing here.
reads.why: The feed misses small restaurants and shops, which are most of Hermosa's employers.

reads.evidence: Down 6.3%, with a mean commute of 28.5 minutes.
reads.quality: A small beach town losing residents changes fast: fewer regulars for the businesses that are left.
reads.move: Check how many homes are occupied year-round.
reads.why: The drop is official. The cause is our guess.
